newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-BLONDEAU SURE OF HIS WEDNESDAY CHOICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLONDEAU SURE OF HIS WEDNESDAY CHOICE.

text.p: Monaco's French international defender Patrick Blondeau is sure he has made the right choice in joining Sheffield Wednesday rather than Inter Milan or Glasgow Rangers.

The 29-year-old signed a three-year contract at the weekend and said: "I love England, I've always had the feeling. On meeting the Sheffield directors that feeling was reinforced. Well, Sheffield is an industrial city, a people of workers.

"...They are aware of the real values of football... In Italy, Spain, France people give importance to the movement of an attacker, the dribble of a playmaker. In England, people have long understood that a clean tackle is also spectacular."
